title: opnsrcntrbtr/sebi-circular-rag
summary: SEBI Circular Retrieval-Augmented Generation系统，基于本地数据，针对印度SEBI公告进行抓取、分段和索引，采用混合搜索和跨编码重排序进行检索，生成基于放弃阈值的答案，并返回具有撤销状态和忠诚度检查的引用。使用HTML和配置文件实现，适用于法律和金融领域。，基于模型推理的架构
description: A local-first, Apple-Silicon Retrieval-Augmented Generation system over Indian SEBI circulars. It scrapes official circulars, segments and indexes them, retrieves with hybrid search + cross-encoder reranking, generates grounded answers with an abstention gate, and returns citations with supersession
